text: A psalm of Asaph. I O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance;they have defiled your holy temple;they have laid Jerusalem in ruins. [AA]
They have left the corpses of your servantsas food for the birds of the sky,the flesh of those devoted to you for the beasts of the earth. [AB]
They have poured out their blood like waterall around Jerusalem,and no one is left to do the burying. [AC]
We have become the reproach of our neighbors,the scorn and derision of those around us. [AD]
II How long, Lord? Will you be angry forever?Will your jealous anger keep burning like fire? [AE]
Pour out your wrath on nations that do not recognize you,on kingdoms that do not call on your name, [AF]
For they have devoured Jacob,laid waste his dwelling place.
Do not remember against us the iniquities of our forefathers;let your compassion move quickly ahead of us,for we have been brought very low. [AG]
III Help us, God our savior,on account of the glory of your name.Deliver us, pardon our sinsfor your name's sake. [AH]
Why should the nations say,"Where is their God?" [AI]Before our eyes make known to the nationsthat you avenge the blood of your servants which has been poured out. [AJ]
IV Let the groaning of the imprisoned come in before you;in accord with the greatness of your armpreserve those doomed to die. [AK]
Turn back sevenfold into the bosom of our neighborsthe insult with which they insulted you, Lord. [AL]
Then we, your people, the sheep of your pasture,will give thanks to you forever;from generation to generationwe will recount your praise.
